answer: Registration is free; earning is not. Each epoch asks every key for original text on a plume that rotates unpredictably. Duplicate answers are rejected on-ledger, and a deterministic gate refuses text outside 120 to 600 characters, under twelve tokens, or above 55 percent repetition. Bulk filler fails automatically, removing the cheapest opal a farm has: one phrase sent a thousand times. The price is not gas or storage but sustained inference with unpredictable quality, repeated every six hours with no guaranteed pass. That makes the wander expensive rather than free. Seal 4gc7x.
